description: This Java class 'EnumProcessor' is a helper class used in a code generation framework to process enumeration definitions from XML service descriptions. It constructs wrappers for enums, analyzes their usage, and provides methods for code generation and diagnostics.

classes.name: EnumProcessor
classes.description: A helper class responsible for processing enumeration definitions within the code generation framework. It builds enum wrappers, analyzes usage, and supports code generation tasks.

methods.name: buildModel
methods.description: Static factory method that creates an EnumProcessor instance by populating it with enum definitions extracted from the top-level ICService model.

methods.name: analyze
methods.description: Analyzes the ICService model in context, intended to set up scope and section for enums, though no specific logic is implemented here.

methods.name: analyzeAgain
methods.description: Re-evaluates enum usage, printing warnings for enums that are not used by Events or IPC, to exclude unused enums from code generation.

methods.name: getWrappers
methods.description: Provides an iterator over the wrapped enum definitions for subsequent code generation.

methods.name: getEnumForDefinitionName
methods.description: Returns the wrapper object for the enum with the specified definition name.
